title: 第一卷 第327章 宁王府进贼了
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林修嘿嘿的笑了一声。

陈炎白了他一眼，把他叫到了面前。

“你去库房支五十万两。”

林修手里的笔差点掉了。

“多少？”

“五十万两。”

“世子，您说的是银子，不是铜板吧？”

陈炎看他，“我像是分不清银子和铜板的人吗？”

说着，他拿出宁王府令牌，丢给林修。

“拿着。”

“去找李福。”

Page (1/3)

Lin Xiu chuckled.

Chen Yan rolled his eyes at him and called him in front of him.

"You go to the warehouse to pay five hundred thousand taels."

Lin Xiu almost dropped the pen in his hand.

"How much?"

"Fifty thousand taels."

"Your Majesty, you are talking about silver, not copper coins, right?"

Chen Yan looked at him, "Do I look like someone who can't tell the difference between silver and copper coins?"

With that said, he took out the Ning Prince's Mansion token and threw it to Lin Xiu.

"Take it."

"Go find Li Fu."
